original_query: with inv as (select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy        ,stdev,mean, case mean when 0 then null else stdev/mean end cov  from(select w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy             ,stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) stdev,avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) mean       from inventory           ,item           ,warehouse           ,date_dim       where inv_item_sk = i_item_sk         and inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk         and inv_date_sk = d_date_sk         and d_year =2000         and i_category IN ('Books', 'Men')         and i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 and 100         and inv_quantity_on_hand between 376 and 576       group by w_warehouse_name,w_warehouse_sk,i_item_sk,d_moy) foo  where case mean when 0 then 0 else stdev/mean end > 1) select inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean, inv1.cov         ,inv2.w_warehouse_sk,inv2.i_item_sk,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov from inv inv1,inv inv2 where inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk   and inv1.w_warehouse_sk =  inv2.w_warehouse_sk   and inv1.d_moy=1   and inv2.d_moy=1+1   and inv1.cov > 1.5 order by inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean,inv1.cov         ,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean, inv2.cov ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    s.w_warehouse_sk,
    s.i_item_sk,
    1 AS d_moy,
    s.mean_1 AS mean,
    s.cov_1 AS cov,
    s.w_warehouse_sk,
    s.i_item_sk,
    2 AS d_moy,
    s.mean_2 AS mean,
    s.cov_2 AS cov
FROM (
    SELECT
        w_warehouse_sk,
        i_item_sk,
        avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d_moy = 1) AS mean_1,
        stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d_moy = 1)
            / NULLIF(avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d_moy = 1), 0) AS cov_1,
        avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d_moy = 2) AS mean_2,
        stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d_moy = 2)
            / NULLIF(avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) FILTER (WHERE d_moy = 2), 0) AS cov_2
    FROM inventory
    JOIN item ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse ON inventory.inv_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2000
      AND date_dim.d_moy IN (1, 2)
      AND item.i_category IN ('Books', 'Men')
      AND item.i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100
      AND inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 376 AND 576
    GROUP BY w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk
) s
WHERE s.cov_1 > 1.5
  AND s.cov_2 > 1
ORDER BY s.w_warehouse_sk, s.i_item_sk, s.mean_1, s.cov_1, s.mean_2, s.cov_2;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The final query only uses d_moy = 1 and d_moy = 2, so the CTE was aggregating 12 months unnecessarily. Restricting d_moy IN (1, 2) before aggregation reduces scanned/aggregated inventory rows by roughly 6x. Also, the CASE mean WHEN 0 check is impossible under the quantity range 376-576, and NULLIF simplifies the covariance expression equivalently.

The original CTE is referenced twice, causing materialization and a self-join. Replaced with a single-pass conditional aggregation (FILTER clauses) that computes month 1 and month 2 statistics together, eliminating CTE materialization and the self-join.

The CTE filter cov > 1 is redundant for inv1 (outer filter is cov > 1.5) but must be preserved for inv2. The rewritten query applies cov_1 > 1.5 and cov_2 > 1, preserving exact semantics while filtering earlier.

Converted implicit comma joins to explicit ANSI JOINs. Since w_warehouse_sk is the warehouse primary key, grouping by w_warehouse_name is unnecessary; grouping by w_warehouse_sk and i_item_sk is sufficient and produces one row per warehouse/item.
Folded inv2.d_moy = 1 + 1 into d_moy = 2 and moved it into the pre-aggregation date filter, so only months 1 and 2 are read from date_dim and joined against inventory.
